interpretation: The decoder's private Float64 backing is independent and avoids an ordinary-array rebuild, but exposing it directly would currently reject saved geometry or silently lose precision in a finite Split path. TypeScript structural compatibility does not detect these runtime branches. A complete carrier migration must audit validation, all geometry/worker paths, serialization, rendering, history and GUI/MCP parity before use.
limitations: The runtime test covers three selected paths only; 67 source files contain Float32Array checks and require contextual review, not blanket replacement.
No application code or restore behavior changed, and no full PLY-3 or native acceptance was performed in this probe.
